Batch 1's fix pass is done. Group **c** reviewed it (`research/frontier-18-alpha-c-step3-scaffold-review.md`); three findings carry the `B1-` prefix.

**B1-1 — applied** (blocking). `lem-four-square-congruence-for-primes` no longer re-derives the published `prop-every-nonzero-residue-mod-prime-is-a-sum-of-two-squares`. Verified on disk first: `status: published`, `literature-derived` statement, paired-judge pass 2026-08-23, `audited: 2026-08-24`, homed on the A page `sums-of-two-squares` at order 57.007. The odd case now cites it at $a=-1$ (hypothesis $p\nmid-1$ discharged from `def-divides-in-z` + `lem-units-of-z` against $p>1$), $p=2$ stays the direct check, and the five counting deps came out of `deps` and out of the contract facts. The contract entry was rewritten end to end — six facts, six derivations, all eight boundary cases redispositioned against the new proof rather than carried over.

Two things beyond the letter of the finding, both flagged in the notes for Alpha to reverse if unwanted: `def-integers-modulo-n` also came out, because the new proof never forms a residue class and the edge would be unconsumed; and the B-page example `ex-four-square-congruence-for-an-odd-prime`, which displays the two square sets mod 11, now attributes that display to the proposition it instantiates and carries a dep edge to it — otherwise it pointed at an argument no longer on the A page.

**B1-2** (Conrad Thm 5.1, owner decision) and **B1-3** (empty `finite_smoke`, routed to the owner and the engine) — no action, recorded with reasons. My own nine findings: eight are design-scaffold amendments the lead Alpha applies at step 4 and were already reflected in these artifacts; Finding 5 is B1-1.

Gates re-run: coverage-checklist 0/0, content-policy 0 errors (26 items batch-scoped), validate-plan OK, prosecheck 0 errors. On a scratch spliced spec outside the repo, `depsource` gives A page 49 external deps all published / 0 unresolved, B page 30 with 7 published. Contract quotes re-verified by substring against disk: 56 published citations, 56 exact. The seam is closed — one dep edge from each page into `sums-of-two-squares`, where both had zero. `proof-contract`/`risk-report` still report 24 `item-missing`, which is the correct pre-authoring state and not a pass I'm claiming.
